name: Western Science Center Junior Volunteer Program
what_you_do: Get paired with a museum staff mentor and grow your interest in science and museums. Volunteers help in many parts of the museum, from fossil lab work to the museum floor.
who_can_apply: You must be 12 to 17. The museum picks teens based on interests, answers on the form and open time slots.
duration: By semester. Hours are not listed.
deadline_text: Forms are reviewed each semester and as slots open. The program starts two weeks after each HUSD school semester begins.
how_to_apply: Fill out the Junior Volunteer form on the museum page. It asks for a parent contact and two emergency contacts. If you are not picked, you can apply again next semester.
notes: The volunteer page lists a reference check, a background check and training for all volunteers. Forms are checked on Wednesdays. If you hear nothing after 7 business days, call 951-791-0033.
